G4200.def:
πορισμός, -ου, ὁ
(πορίζω, to procure), [in LXX: Wis.13:19 14:2 * ;] 
__1. a providing. 
__2. a means of gain: 1 Timothée 6:5-6 (Polyb., al.).†

G4201.def:
Πόρκιος, -ου, ὁ 
Porcius, prænomen of Porcius Festus (see: Φῆστος): Actes 24:27.†

G4202.def:
πορνεία, -ας, ἡ
(πορνεύω), [in LXX for תַּזְנוּת and cogn. forms ;] 
fornication: Actes 15:20, 29 21:25, 1 Corinthiens 5:1 6:13 6:18, 2 Corinthiens 12:21, Galates 5:19, Éphésiens 5:3, Colossiens 3:5, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:3 (Lft., Notes, 53), Apocalypse 9:21; pl. (see WM, 220; Bl., § 32, 6), 1 Corinthiens 7:2; disting. from μοιχεία, Matthieu 15:19, Marc 7:21; = μοιχεία (Amos 8:17 Sir.23:23, al.), Matthieu 5:32 19:9. Metaphorical (of idolatry: Deutéronome 23:2, Osée 1:2): Jean 8:41 (Westc., in l), and so perh. (Thayer-Grimm, see word; but see Swete, in 11.), Apocalypse 2:21 14:18 17:2, 4 18:3 19:2.†

G4203.def:
πορνεύω 
[in LXX for זָנָה ;] 
__1. to prostitute the body for hire. 
__2. to commit fornication: Marc 10:19 (WH, mg), 1 Corinthiens 6:18 10:8, Apocalypse 2:14, 20. Metaphorical (as in LXX: 1 Chroniques 5:25, Jérémie 3:6, Osée 9:1, al.), of idolatry (but see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), Apocalypse 17:2 18:3, 9 (cf. ἐκ- πορνεύω).†

G4204.def:
πόρνη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for זָנָה ;] 
a prostitute, harlot: Matthieu 21:31-32, Luc 15:30, 1 Corinthiens 6:15-16 Hébreux 11:31, Jacques 2:25. Metaphorical (see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), of Babylon (i.e. Rome): Apocalypse 17:1, 5 17:15-16 19:2.†

G4205.def:
πόρνος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Sir.23:16-18 * ;] 
__1. a male prostitute (Xen., al.). 
__2. a fornicator: 1 Corinthiens 5:9-11 6:9, Éphésiens 5:5, 1 Timothée 1:10, Hébreux 12:15 13:4, Apocalypse 21:8 22:15.†

G4206.def:
πόρρω 
adv. (in older Attic, πρόσω), [in LXX for רָחוֹק, etc. ;] 
far off: Matthieu 15:8, Marc 7:6" (LXX), Luc 14:32; comparat., πορρώτερον (-ρω, T), Luc 24:28.†

G4207.def:
πόρρωθεν 
adv. (τόρρω, which see), [in LXX for רָחוֹק and cogn. forms ;] 
from afar: Luc 17:12, Hébreux 11:13.†

G4209.def:
πορφύρα, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן, אַרְגְּוָן ;] 
__1. the purple fish (cf. 1Ma.4:23). 
__2. purple dye. 
__3. Later, = πορφυρίς, a purple gar­ment: Marc 15:17, 20, Luc 16:19, Apocalypse 18:12.†

G4210.def:
πορφύρεος, -α, -ον contr., -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν 
(ποπφύρα), [in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן ;] 
purple: Jean 19:2, 5; as subst., πορφυροῦν (sc. ἱμάτιον), Apocalypse 17:4 18:6.†

G4211.def:
πορφυρόπωλις, -ιδος, ἡ 
a seller of purple fabrics: Actes 16:14.†

G4212.def:
ποσάκις 
interrog. num. adv., 
how often: Matthieu 18:21 23:37, Luc 13:34.†

G4213.def:
πόσις, -εως, ἡ
(πίνω), [in LXX: Da, LXX TH Daniel 1:10 (מִשְׁתֶּה) * ;] 
__1. prop., drinking: Romains 14:17, Colossiens 2:16 (see Lft.; ICC, in l). 
__2. = πόμα, drink: Jean 6:55 (cf. βρῶσις).†

G4214.def:
πόσος, -η, -ον 
adj. of number, magnitude, degree, etc., 
how much, how great, how many: Matthieu 6:23, 2 Corinthiens 7:11; of time, Marc 9:21; neut., absol., Luc 16:5, 7; dative, πόσῳ, adverbially, how much, Matthieu 12:12; id. before μᾶλλον, Matthieu 7:11 10:25, Luc 11:13 12:24, 28, Romains 11:12, 24, Phm 16, Hébreux 9:14; π. χείρονος τιμωρίας, Hébreux 10:29; pl., Matthieu 15:34 16:9-10 27:13, Marc 6:38 8:5, 19-20 15:4, Luc 15:17, Actes 21:20.†

G4215.def:
ποταμός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for נָהָר, יְאֹר ;] 
a river, stream, torrent: Matthieu 3:5 7:25, 27, Marc 1:1-45 :, Luc 6:48-49, Actes 16:13, 2 Corinthiens 11:26, Apocalypse 8:10 9:14 12:15-16 16:4, 12 21:1-2. Fig., pl., π. ὕδατος ζῶντος, Jean 7:38.†

G4216.def:
ποταμο-φόρητος, -ον 
carried away by a stream: 
Apocalypse 12:15 (for two exx. in π., see MM, xxi).†

G4217.def:
ποταπός
(late form of cl. ποδ-), -ή, -όν, [in LXX: Dan LXX Su 1:54* ;] 
__1. (= ποδαπός) from what country? 
__2. In late writers, = ποῖος, of what sort?: Matthieu 8:27, Marc 13:1, Luc 1:29 7:39, 2 Pierre 3:11, 1 Jean 3:1.†

G4218.def:
ποτέ 
enclitic particle, 
__1. once, formerly, sometime: of the past, Jean 9:13 Romains 7:9 11:30, Galates 1:13, 23 2:6 (Lft., in l), Éphésiens 2:2-3, 11 2:13 5:8, Colossiens 1:21 3:7, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:5, Tite 3:3, Phm 11, 1 Pierre 2:10 3:5 3:20; ἤδη ποτέ, now at length, Philippiens 4:10; of the fut., Luc 22:32; εἴ πως ἤδη ποτέ, if sometime soon at length, Romains 1:10. 
__2. ever: after a neg., Éphésiens 5:29, 2 Pierre 1:10 1:21; in a question, τίς π., 1 Corinthiens 9:7, Hébreux 1:5, 13.†

G4219.def:
πότε 
interrog. adv. of time, 
when?: Matthieu 25:37-39, 44 Luc 21:7, Jean 6:25; ἕως π., how long: Matthieu 17:17, Marc 9:19, Luc 9:41, Jean 10:24, Apocalypse 6:10. In indir. questions, = ὁπότε, Matthieu 24:3, Marc 13:4, 33 13:35, Luc 12:36 17:20 (see Bl., § 25, 4).†

G4220.def:
πότερος, -α, -ον 
which of two. Neut., adverbially, πότερον, whether: Jean 7:17.†

G4221.def:
ποτήριον, -ου, τό dimin. of ποτήρ 
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for כּוֹס:] 
a wine cup: Matthieu 23:25-26 26:27, Marc 7:4 14:23, Luc 11:39 22:17, 20 a (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1 Corinthiens 11:25, Apocalypse 17:4; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., 1 Corinthiens 11:28; with genitive of thing(s), Matthieu 10:42, Marc 9:41; τ. εὐλογίας, 1 Corinthiens 10:16; by meton., of the contents of the cup, Luc 22:20 b (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1 Corinthiens 11:25-26; with genitive of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 10:21 11:27. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity (Psaumes 16:5, al.); of adversity (Psaumes 11:6, Ésaïe 51:17, al.): of the sufferings of Christ, Matthieu 20:22-23 26:39 10:38-39 14:36, Luc 22:42, Jean 18:11; of divine punishment, Apocalypse 14:10 16:19 18:6.†

G4222.def:
ποτίζω
(πότος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁקָה hi. ;] 
to give to drink: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 25:35, 37 25:42 27:48, Marc 15:36, Luc 13:15, Romains 12:20; with dupl. accusative, Matthieu 10:42, Marc 9:41; fig., γάλα, 1 Corinthiens 3:2; ἐκ τ. οἴνου Apocalypse 14:8; of plants, to water (Xen., Strab., al.; Genèse 13:10), figuratively, 1 Corinthiens 3:6-8 Metaphorical (cf. Ésaïe 29:10 Sir.15:3), of the Spirit, 1 Corinthiens 12:13.†

G4223.def:
Ποτίολοι, -ων, οἱ 
Puteoli (mod. Pozzuoli), a city on the Bay of Naples: Actes 28:13.†

G4224.def:
πότος, -ου, ὁ
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁתֶּה ;] 
a drinking bout, carousal: 1 Pierre 4:3.†
SYN.: see: κραιπάλη

G4225.def:
πού 
enclitic particle, 
__1. anywhere, somewhere: Hébreux 2:6 4:4. 
__2. in some degree, perhaps, about: Actes 27:29 (T, μήπου), Romains 4:19; δή που (T, δήπου), surely: Hébreux 2:16.†

G4226.def:
ποῦ 
interrog. adv., [in LXX for אַי, אַיֵּה, אָן ;] 
__1. prop., where?: Matthieu 2:2 26:17, Marc 14:12, 14, Luc 17:17, 37 22:9, 11, Jean 1:39 7:11 8:10, 19 9:12 11:34; ποῦ (ἐστιν), indicating that the subject in question is not to be found, Luc 8:25, Romains 3:27, 1 Corinthiens 1:20 12:17 12:19 15:55, Galates 4:15, 2 Pierre 3:4; ποῦ φανεῖται, 1 Pierre 4:18. 
__2. = ὅπου (WM, 640; B1., § 50, 5): with indic., Matthieu 2:4, Marc 15:47, Jean 1:40 11:57 20:2, 13 20:15 Apocalypse 2:13; with subjc., Matthieu 8:20, Luc 9:58 12:17. 
__3. In colloq. (as in Eng.) = ποῖ, whither: in direct questions, Jean 7:35 9:12 13:36 16:5; in indir. quest., Jean 3:8 8:14 12:35 14:5, Hébreux 11:8, 1 Jean 2:11.†

G4227.def:
Πούδης
(in π., genitive -εντος, see Zorell, see word), ὁ (Latin) 
Pudens: 2 Timothée 4:21.†

G4228.def:
πούς, ποδός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for רֶגֶל ;] 
a foot, both of men and beasts: Matthieu 4:6 (LXX), Marc 9:45, Luc 1:79, Jean 11:44, Actes 7:5, al.; ὑπο τοὺς π., Romains 16:20, 1 Corinthiens 15:25 15:27 Éphésiens 1:22, Hébreux 2:8; ὑποκάτω τῶν π., Matthieu 22:44 (LXX); πρὸς (παρὰ) τοὺς π., Marc 5:22, Luc 8:41, al.; figuratively, Matthieu 15:30, Luc 10:39, Actes 5:2, al.; ἔμπροσθεν τῶν π., Apocalypse 3:9 19:10, al.; ἐπὶ τοὺς π., Actes 10:25. By meton., of a person in motion (Psaumes 119:101): Luc 1:79, Actes 5:9, Romains 3:15 10:15, Hébreux 12:13

G4229.def:
πρᾶγμα, -τος, τύ
(πράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר ;] 
__1. that which has been done, a deed, act: Luc 1:1, Actes 5:4, 2 Corinthiens 7:11, Hébreux 6:18. 
__2. That which is being done (like Lat. res), hence, a thing, matter, affair: Matthieu 18:19, Romains 16:2, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:6 (see M, Th., in l), Hébreux 10:1 11:1, Jacques 3:16; in forensic sense (as frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 233), a law-suit: 1 Corinthiens 6:1.†

G4230.def:
πραγματία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ 
(πραγματεύομαι) [in LXX for חֲשַׁל, etc. ;] 
__1. careful application, hard work. 
__2. business, occupation: pl., 2 Timothée 2:4.†

G4231.def:
πραγματεύομαι
(πρᾶγμα), [in LXX: 3Ki.10:22 B, 3Ki.9:19 A (חָשַׁק), Dan LXX 8:27 (מְלָאכָה ־אֵת עָשָׂה) * ;] 
__1. to busy oneself. 
__2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: Luc 19:13 (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).†

G4232.def:
πραιτώριον, -ου, τό (Lat. prætorium) 
__1. headquarters in a Roman camp, 
__2. The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province: Matthieu 27:27, Marc 15:16 (see Swete, in l), Jean 18:28, 33 19:9; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, Actes 23:35. 
__3. the Prætorian Guard: Philippiens 1:13 (see Lft., in l; ICC, 51 f.).†

G4233.def:
πράκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: Ésaïe 3:12 (נָגַשׁ) * ;] 
__1. (poët.) one who does or accomplishes. 
__2. In Athens, one who exacts payment, a collector; hence, generally (frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 154), a court officer: Luc 12:58.†

G4234.def:
πρᾶξις, -εως, ἡ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: 2 Chroniques 13:22 27:7 28:26 (דֶּרֶךְ), Job 24:5 A (פֹּעַל), Proverbes 13:13, Wis.9:11, al. ;] 
__1. a doing, deed, act: Matthieu 16:27; pl., π. ἀποσπτόλων, Ac, title; in late writers especially of wicked deeds or practices (frequently in Polyb.): Luc 23:51; p1., Romains 8:13, Colossiens 3:9; with ref. to magic (see BS, 3235), Actes 19:18. 
__2. an acting, action, business, function: Romains 12:4.†

G4235.def:
πρᾷος, πρᾶος, see: πραΰς.
πραΰς, -εῖα, -ΰ, and πρᾷος
(Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), [in LXX (always -ΰς, exc. 2Ma.15:12, -ᾷος, see Thackeray, Gr., 180 f.) for עָנָו, עָנִי ;] 
gentle, meek: Matthieu 5:5 11:29 21:5" (LXX) 1 Pierre 3:4.†

G4236.def:
πρᾳότης, πραότης, see: πραΰτης.
πραΰτης
(Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Psaumes 45:4 90:10 132:1 (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, Esther 5:1, Sir.6:1-37 * ;] 
gentleness, meekness: 1 Corinthiens 4:21, 2 Corinthiens 10:1, Galates 5:23 6:1, Éphésiens 4:2, Colossiens 3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tite 3:2, Jacques 1:21 3:13, 1 Pierre 3:15.†
SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v

G4237.def:
πρασιά, -ᾶς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Sir.24:31 * ;] 
a garden-bed; metaphorically, of ranks or orderly groups of persons: Marc 6:40.†

G4238.def:
πράσσω 
(Att.. -ττω, and so Actes 17:7 Rec.; cf. M, Pr., 25, 45), [in LXX chiefly for עָשָׂה, פָּעַל ;] 
= Lat agere, as ποιέω (which see) = facere, 
__1. to do, practise, be engaged in: Actes 19:19, 36, 1 Corinthiens 9:17; τ. ἴδια π., to mind one's own business (τὰ ἑαυτοῦ, Soph., Plat.), 1 Thessaloniciens 4:11; intrans., to act, Actes 17:7. 
__2. to achieve, effect, accomplish, perform: Actes 26:20, 26 Romains 7:15 9:11, 2 Corinthiens 5:10, Philippiens 4:9; νόμον (ICC, in l), Romains 2:25; of unworthy acts (for WH. usually ποιέω in cl.), to commit, do: Luc 22:23 23:41, Jean 3:20 5:29, Actes 3:17 5:35 16:28 25:11, 25 26:9, 31, Romains 1:32 (ICC, in l), Romains 2:1-3 7:19 13:4, 1 Corinthiens 5:2, 2 Corinthiens 12:21, Galates 5:21. 
__3. to transact, manage, hence, of payment, to exact (cl.): Luc 3:13 19:23. 
__4. Reflexively, of state or condition, to do or fare Æsch., Hdt., al.): Éphésiens 6:21; εὖ π. (see M, Pr., 228 f.), Actes 15:29.†
SYN.: see: ποιέω

G4240.def:
πραΰτης
(Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Psaumes 45:4 90:10 132:1 (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, Esther 5:1, Sir.6:1-37 * ;] 
gentleness, meekness: 1 Corinthiens 4:21, 2 Corinthiens 10:1, Galates 5:23 6:1, Éphésiens 4:2, Colossiens 3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tite 3:2, Jacques 1:21 3:13, 1 Pierre 3:15.†
SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v

G4241.def:
πρέπω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 93:5 (נָאָה pi.), etc. ;] 
__1. to be clearly seen. 
__2. to resemble. 
__3. to be fitting or becoming, to suit: with dative, Hébreux 7:26, 1 Timothée 2:10, Tite 2:1; impers., with dative, Éphésiens 5:3; id. before inf., Hébreux 2:10; πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., Matthieu 3:15; with accusative and inf., 1 Corinthiens 11:13 (see Bl., § 72, 5).†

G4242.def:
πρεσβεία, -ας, ἡ
(πρεσβεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:11 * ;] 
__1. age, seniority. 
__2. rank, dignity. 
__3. an embassy; by meton., of the am­bassadors, embassy: Luc 14:32 19:14.†

G4243.def:
πρεσβεύω
(πρέσβυς), 
__1. to be the elder, to take precedence. 
__2. to be an ambassador (see: πρεσβύτης): 2 Corinthiens 5:20, Éphésiens 6:20.†

G4244.def:
πρεσβυτέριον, -ου, τό
(πρεσβύτερος) [in LXX: Da TH Su 1:50 A * ;] 
a body of elders, presbytery: of the Sanhedrin (cf. συνέδριον), Luc 22:66, Actes 22:5; of Christian presbyters, 1 Timothée 4:14.†

G4245G.def:
πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see), 
[in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): Nombres 21:20 (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), Ésaïe 13:8 57:9 (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;] 
an old man. 
Compar., 
πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον, 
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;] 
__1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., Luc 15:25; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, Actes 2:17; to νεώτερος, 1 Timothée 5:1-2; of the religious leaders of the past, Matthieu 15:2, Marc 7:3, 5, Hébreux 11:2 (= οἱ πατέρες, Hébreux 1:1). 
__2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373); 
__(a) among Jews: Matthieu 16:21 26:47, 57 27:3, 12 27:20, 41 28:12, Marc 8:31 11:27 14:43, 53 15:1, Luc 7:3 9:22 20:1 22:52, Jean 8:9, Actes 4:5, 8 4:23 6:12 23:14 24:1; τ. Ἰουνδαίων, Actes 25:15; τ. λαοῦ, Matthieu 21:23 26:3 27:1; 
__(b) among Christians: Actes 11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18, 1 Timothée 5:17 5:19, Tite 1:5, II Jn 1, 3Jn.1, 1 Pierre 5:1 5:5; τ. ἐκκλησίας, Actes 20:17, Jacques 5:14; 
__(with) in the visions of the Apocalypse: Apocalypse 4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4. 
(On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) †

G4245H.def:
πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see), 
[in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): Nombres 21:20 (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), Ésaïe 13:8 57:9 (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;] 
an old man. 
Compar., 
πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον, 
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;] 
__1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., Luc 15:25; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, Actes 2:17; to νεώτερος, 1 Timothée 5:1-2; of the religious leaders of the past, Matthieu 15:2, Marc 7:3, 5, Hébreux 11:2 (= οἱ πατέρες, Hébreux 1:1). 
__2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373); 
__(a) among Jews: Matthieu 16:21 26:47, 57 27:3, 12 27:20, 41 28:12, Marc 8:31 11:27 14:43, 53 15:1, Luc 7:3 9:22 20:1 22:52, Jean 8:9, Actes 4:5, 8 4:23 6:12 23:14 24:1; τ. Ἰουνδαίων, Actes 25:15; τ. λαοῦ, Matthieu 21:23 26:3 27:1; 
__(b) among Christians: Actes 11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18, 1 Timothée 5:17 5:19, Tite 1:5, II Jn 1, 3Jn.1, 1 Pierre 5:1 5:5; τ. ἐκκλησίας, Actes 20:17, Jacques 5:14; 
__(with) in the visions of the Apocalypse: Apocalypse 4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4. 
(On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) †

G4246.def:
πρεσβύτης, -ου prose form of πρέσβυς, which see, 
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן, Genèse 25:8, al.; also (= πρεσβευτής), 2 Chroniques 32:31 Bl (לוּץ), 1Ma.14:22 S, al. (see Thackeray, Gr., 97) ;] 
__1. an old man: Luc 1:18, Tite 2:2, Phm 9 (R, txt., but see infr.). 
__2. As in LXX, also = πρεσβευτής, an am­bassador: Phm 9 (R, mg., see Lft. and ICC, in l).†

G4247.def:
πρεσβῦτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of πρεσβύτης, 
[in LXX: 4Ma.16:14 * ;] 
an aged woman: Tite 2:3.†

G4248.def:
πρηνής, -ές
(in Att.. also πρανής), [in LXX: Wis.4:19, 3Ma.5:43 3Mac 5:50 3Mac 6:23 * ;] 
headlong, prone: Actes 1:18.†

G4249.def:
πρίζω = πρίω, 
[in LXX: Amos 1:3, Da TH Su 1:59 * ;] 
to saw, saw asunder (= π. δίχα, Thuc., iv, 100): pass, Hébreux 11:37 (cf. δια-πρίω).†

G4251.def: Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†

G4252.def:
Πρίσκιλλα, see: Πρίσκα.
Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†

G4255.def:
προ-αιρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: for חָשַׁק, etc. ;] 
to bring forth or forward. Most frequently in mid., to take by choice, prefer, propose: 2 Corinthiens 9:7.†

G4256.def:
προ-αιτιάομαι, -ῶμαι 
to accuse or charge beforehand: Romains 3:9 (not elsewhere) .†

G4257.def:
προ-ακούω 
to hear beforehand: Colossiens 1:5 (see Lft., in l).†

G4259.def:
προ-αύλιον, -ου, τό
(πρό, αὐλή), 
a porch, vestibule: Marc 14:68.†

G4260.def:
προ-βαίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] 
to go forwards, go on, advance: Matthieu 4:21, Marc 1:19. Metaphorical, of age (Genèse 18:11, al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, Luc 1:7, 18 2:36.†

G4261.def:
προ-βάλλω 
[in LXX for חוּד, מָרַק, etc. ;] 
__1. to throw before. 
__2. to put forward: with accusative, Actes 19:33; of trees, to put forth, produce (sc. φύλλα), Luc 21:30.†

G4262.def:
προβατικός, -ή, -όν
(πρόβατον) [in LXX (π. πύλη): Néhémie 3:1, 32 12:39 (צֹאן)* ;] 
of sheep: ἡ π. (sc. πύλη, see supr.), the sheep-gate, Jean 5:2.†

G4263.def:
πρόβατον, -ου, τό
(προβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for שֶׂה, more rarely for כֶּבֶשׂ (כֶּשֶׂב), רָחֵל ;] 
__1. in Hom., Hdt., cattle, esp. of small cattle, sheep and goats. 
__2. In NT, as in Attic writers generally (cf. MM, xxi), a sheep: Matthieu 7:15, Marc 6:34, al.; πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Romains 8:36 (LXX). Metaphorical (in cl. of timidity, stupidity or idleness), of the followers of a leader or master, esp. of those who are subject to the care of the Good Shepherd: Matthieu 10:6 15:24 26:31" (LXX) Marc 14:27 (LXX), Jean 10:7-8, 15-16 10:26-27 21:16-17 (WH txt., προβάτια), Hébreux 13:20; opposite to ἐρίφια, Matthieu 25:33. 
προβάτιον, -ου, τό, 
dimin. of πρόβατον (used as a term of endearment, see El., § 27, 4), a little sheep: Jean 21:16-17 (πρόβατα, WH, mg.).†

G4264.def:
προ-βιβάζω causal of προβαίνω, 
[in LXX: Exode 35:34 (יָרָה hi.), Deutéronome 6:7 (שָׁנַן pi.) * ;] 
to lead forward, lead on; metaphorically, to induce, incite, urge: Matthieu 14:8.†

G4265.def:
προ-βλέπω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 37:13 (רָאָה)* ;] 
to foresee: mid., Hébreux 11:40 (see Bl., § 24, 55, 1).†

G4266.def:
προ-γίνομαι 
[in LXX: Wis.19:13 אA, 2Ma.14:3 2Mac 15:8 * ;] 
to happen before: pf. pass. ptcp., Romains 3:25.†

G4267.def:
προ-γινώσκω 
[in LXX: Wis.6:13 8:8 18:6 * ;] 
to know beforehand, foreknow: 2 Pierre 3:17; with accusative of person(s), Actes 26:5; of the Divine foreknowledge, Romains 8:29 11:2, 1 Pierre 1:20.†

G4268.def:
πρό-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(προγινώσκω) [in LXX: Jdth.9:6 11:19 * ;] 
fore­knowledge: Actes 2:23, 1 Pierre 1:2.†

G4269.def:
πρό-γονος, -ον
(προγίνομαι), [in LXX: Esther 4:17, Sir.8:4, al. ;] 
__1. born before. 
__2. As subst., in pl., οἱ π., ancestors, forefathers: 2 Timothée 1:3; of living parents (so Plat.), 1 Timothée 5:4.†

G4270.def:
προ-γράφω 
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:3 cod., 1Ma.10:36 * ;] 
__1. to write before: Romains 15:4, Éphésiens 3:3, Ju 4. 
__2. to write in public, placard, proclaim (Dem., Plut., al.): Galates 3:1 (Lft., in l). 
__3. = ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).†

G4271.def:
πρό-δηλος, -ον 
[in LXX: Jdth.8:29, 2Ma.3:17 2Mac 14:39 * ;] 
__1. evident beforehand. 
__2. clearly evident: 1 Timothée 5:24-25 Hébreux 7:14.†

G4272.def:
προ-δίδωμι 
[in LXX: Eze.16:34 A (נָתַן), 4Ma.4:1, al. ;] 
__1. to give before, give first: Romains 11:35 (Job 41:2 (11) LXX, al.). 
__2. to betray (4Mac, l.with).†

G4273.def:
προ-δότης, -ου, ὁ
(προδίδωμι) [in LXX: 2Ma.5:15 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:22, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] 
a betrayer, traitor: Luc 6:16, Actes 7:52, 2 Timothée 3:4.†

G4274.def:
πρό-δρομος, -ον
(προτρέχω) [in LXX: Nombres 13:21 (20), Ésaïe 28:4 (בִּכּוּר), Wis.12:8 * ;] 
running forward, going in advance. As subst., ὁ π., an advance guard, forerunner: Hébreux 6:20.†

G4276.def:
προ-ελπίζω 
to hope before: before ἐν, Éphésiens 1:12.†

G4277.def:
προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.), 
__1. to say before: Galates 1:9, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Hébreux 4:7; before ὅτι, 2 Corinthiens 7:3 13:2, Galates 5:21; of prophecy, Matthieu 24:25, Marc 13:23, Actes 1:16, Romains 9:29, 2 Pierre 3:2, Ju 17. 
__2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2 Corinthiens 13:2, Galates 5:21, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:6 (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†

G4278.def:
προ-ενάρχομαι 
to begin before: 2 Corinthiens 8:6; with accusative, τὸ θέλειν, 2 Corinthiens 8:10 (not elsewhere).†

G4279.def:
προ-επ-αγγέλλω 
to announce before. Mid., to promise before: with accusative of thing(s), Romains 1:2, 2 Corinthiens 9:5 (Dio. Cass.).†

G4280.def:
προ-ερέω, -ῶ, see: προεῖπον.
προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.), 
__1. to say before: Galates 1:9, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Hébreux 4:7; before ὅτι, 2 Corinthiens 7:3 13:2, Galates 5:21; of prophecy, Matthieu 24:25, Marc 13:23, Actes 1:16, Romains 9:29, 2 Pierre 3:2, Ju 17. 
__2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2 Corinthiens 13:2, Galates 5:21, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:6 (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†

G4281.def:
προ-έρχομαι 
[in LXX: Genèse 33:3, 14 R (עָבַר), Jdth.2:19, Sir.35:10 (Sir.32:10) al ;] 
__1. to go forward, go on, advance: before μικρόν, Matthieu 26:39 and Marc 14:35 (WH, mg., προσελθών): ῥύμην μίαν (cf. Plat., Rep., i, 328e), Actes 12:10. 
__2. Of relative position, to go before, precede: with genitive (cl.; Jth, l.with); with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luc 22:47 (with genitive, Rec.); before ἐνώπιον, Luc 1:17 (cf. Genèse 33:3). 
__3. Of time, to go before or in advance: Actes 20:5, 13 (WH, mg., R, mg.), 2 Corinthiens 9:5; with accusative of person(s) (= cl. φθάνω), Marc 6:33.†

G4282.def:
προ-ετοιμάζω 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 28:24 B, Wis.9:8 * ;] 
to prepare before: with accusative of thing(s), Romains 9:23 (οἱς for ἅ by attraction), Éphésiens 2:10.†

G4283.def:
προ-ευαγγελίζομαι 
to announce glad tidings beforehand: Galates 3:8.†

G4284.def:
προ-έχω 
[in LXX: Job 27:6 A (חָזַק hi.) * ;] 
__1. Trans., to hold before; mid., to hold something before oneself (Hdt.), hence, metaphorically, to excuse oneself: Romains 3:9, R, mg. (but see Field, Notes, 152 f.; Lft., Notes, 266 f.; ICC and Vau., in l). 
__2. Intrans. 
__(a) to project; 
__(b) in running, to have the start, hence, metaphorically, to excel: pass., Ro, l.with, R, txt. (see reff. supr.).†

G4285.def:
προ-ηγέσμαι 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 20:9 (בְּרוֹשׁ), Proverbes 17:14 (פָּנִים), 2Ma.4:40, al. ;] 
__1. to go before as leader (in cl., with genitive, dative): Romains 12:10 (Chrys., Vg., al.; see ICC, in l). 
__2. In a sense not elsewhere found, ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι = ἀ. ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας: Ro, l.with (ICC, cf. 1 Thessaloniciens 5:13, Philippiens 2:3 and EV "preferring").†

G4286.def:
πρό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ 
[in LXX: Exode 40:4, 23 (עֵרֶךְ), 1 Chroniques 9:32, al. (מַעֲרֶכֶת), 2 Chroniques 4:19 (פָּנִים), 1Ma.1:22, 2Ma.3:8, al. ;] 
__1. a setting forth (Plat., Plut., al.): οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with, elsewhere ἄρτοι ἐνώπιοι, Exode 25:29; οἱ ἄ. τοῦ προσώπου, Néhémie 10:33), Matthieu 12:4, Marc 2:26, Luc 6:4; ἡ π. τῶν ἄρτων, Hébreux 9:2. 
__2. a purpose (Mist., Polyb., al.; 2Mac, l.with): Actes 11:23 27:13, Romains 8:28 9:11, Éphésiens 1:11 3:11, 2 Timothée 1:9 3:10.†

G4287.def:
προ-θέσμιος, -α, -ον 
[in Sm.: Job 28:3, Daniel 9:26 * ;] 
appointed before­hand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time: Galates 4:2.†

G4288.def:
προθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(πρόθυμος), [in LXX: Sir.45:23 * ;] 
eagerness, willingness, readiness: Actes 17:11, 2 Corinthiens 8:11-12 8:19 9:2.†

G4289.def:
πρόθυμος, -ον 
[in LXX: 1 Chroniques 28:21, 2 Chroniques 29:31 (נָדִיב), Habacuc 1:8 (חוּשׁ), al. ;] 
willing, ready: Matthieu 26:41, Marc 14:38; neut., τὸ π. = ἡ προθυμία (Thuc., al., 3Ma.5:26), οὕτως τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ (= cl. τὸ ἐμὸν) π., Romains 1:15 (but see ICC, in l).†

G4290.def:
προθύμως 
[in LXX: 2 Chroniques 29:34 (יָשָׁר לֵבָב), Tob.7:8, al. ;] 
eagerly, readily, with a ready mind: 1 Pierre 5:2.†

G4292.def:
προ-καλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 A * ;] 
to call forth. 
Most frequently in mid., 
__(a) to challenge; hence, to provoke: Galates 5:26; 
__(b) to invite (2Mac, l.with).†

G4293.def:
προ-κατ-αγγέλλω 
to announce beforehand: with accusative and inf., Actes 3:18; before περί, Actes 7:52.†

G4294.def:
προ-κατ-αρτίζω 
to make ready beforehand: 2 Corinthiens 9:5.†

G4295.def:
πρό-κειμαι 
[in LXX: Exode 39:18 (36), Nombres 4:7 (פָּנִים), etc. ;] 
used as pass. of προτίθημι; 
__1. to be set before one, to be set forth: Hébreux 6:18 12:1-2, Ju 7. 
__2. to present oneself, be present: 2 Corinthiens 8:12 (see Mey., in l).†

G4296.def:
προ-κηρύσσω 
__1. to proclaim by herald. 
__2. Of one who acts as a herald, to proclaim: Actes 13:24.†

G4297.def:
προ-κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.51:17, 2Ma.8:8 * ;] 
progress (prop., on a journey, then generally): Philippiens 1:12, 25, 1 Timothée 4:15 (condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 158).†

G4298.def:
προ-κόπτω 
[in Sm.: Psaumes 45:5 * ;] 
to cut forward a way, for­ward, advance, in cl. trans. with neut. adj., as οὐδὲν π., τὰ πολλὰ π. In late writers (Polyb., al.), wholly intrans., to advance, progress: of time, Romains 13:12. Metaphorical, Luc 2:52, Galates 1:14, 2 Timothée 2:16 3:9 3:13.†

G4299.def:
πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό
(cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand), 
pre-judging, prejudice: 1 Timothée 5:21 (see Cremer, 378).†
